headline: Frequent Reworks of Path Parser Logic
diagnosis: The commit history indicates a recurring issue with the handling of path identifiers, particularly around language and versioning. Several commits have focused on fixing or reverting changes related to these identifiers, suggesting instability in this area of the code.
plan: Conduct a thorough review of the identifier handling logic, especially the functions isCustomWrapperIdentifier and parsePrefixIdentifier, to identify potential edge cases or bugs.
Create a comprehensive set of unit tests that cover various scenarios for path identifiers, including edge cases for language and version handling.
Engage with the authors of the recent commits to gather insights on the challenges they faced, ensuring that their experiences inform the refactoring process.
Establish a code review checklist specifically for changes to the path parsing logic to prevent future regressions.
owner_hint: Ownership should be shared among the authors of recent commits to ensure knowledge retention.
